# `adt import`

Import ABAP objects to various formats (abapGit, etc.)

```bash
adt import [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                | Description                                                                           |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt import object`    | Import a single ABAP object by name (searches, resolves type, and creates local file) |
| `adt import package`   | Import an ABAP package and its contents                                               |
| `adt import transport` | Import a transport request and its objects                                            |

## `adt import object`

Import a single ABAP object by name (searches, resolves type, and creates local file)

```bash
adt import object [options] <objectName> [targetFolder]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument         | Description                                                 | Default |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<objectName>`   | ABAP object name to import (e.g., ZAGE_DOMA_CASE_SENSITIVE) |         |
| `[targetFolder]` | Target folder for output                                    |         |

**Options**

| Option                        | Description                                                                | Default   |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-o, --output <path>`         | Output directory (overrides targetFolder)                                  | ``        |
| `--format <format>`           | Output format: abapgit \| @abapify/adt-plugin-abapgit                      | `abapgit` |
| `--format-option <key=value>` | Format-specific option (repeatable), e.g. --format-option folderLogic=full | `[]`      |
| `-t, --object-type <type>`    | Exact ABAP object type for same-named objects, e.g. DDLX                   |           |
| `--debug`                     | Enable debug output                                                        | `false`   |

## `adt import package`

Import an ABAP package and its contents

```bash
adt import package [options] <packageName> [targetFolder]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument         | Description                 | Default |
| ---------------- | --------------------------- | ------- |
| `<packageName>`  | ABAP package name to import |         |
| `[targetFolder]` | Target folder for output    |         |

**Options**

| Option                       | Description                                                                           | Default   |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-o, --output <path>`        | Output directory (overrides targetFolder)                                             | ``        |
| `-t, --object-types <types>` | Comma-separated object types (e.g., CLAS,INTF,DDLS). Default: all supported by format |           |
| `--no-sub-packages`          | Exclude subpackages (by default subpackages are included)                             |           |
| `--format <format>`          | Output format: abapgit \| @abapify/adt-plugin-abapgit                                 | `abapgit` |
| `--debug`                    | Enable debug output                                                                   | `false`   |

## `adt import transport`

Import a transport request and its objects

```bash
adt import transport [options] <transports> [targetFolder]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument         | Description                                                                                 | Default |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<transports>`   | Transport request number(s) to import (comma-separated for multiple: DEVK900001,DEVK900002) |         |
| `[targetFolder]` | Target folder for output                                                                    |         |

**Options**

| Option                        | Description                                                                                                            | Default   |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `-o, --output <path>`         | Output directory (overrides targetFolder)                                                                              | ``        |
| `-t, --object-types <types>`  | Comma-separated object types (e.g., CLAS,INTF,DDLS). Default: all supported by format                                  |           |
| `--format <format>`           | Output format: abapgit \| @abapify/adt-plugin-abapgit                                                                  | `abapgit` |
| `--format-option <key=value>` | Format-specific option (repeatable), e.g. --format-option folderLogic=full                                             | `[]`      |
| `--folder-logic <logic>`      | [DEPRECATED] Use --format-option folderLogic=&lt;logic&gt;                                                             |           |
| `--apply-deletions`           | Remove local files for objects marked with obj_func=D and pgmid=R3TR (default: on)                                     | `true`    |
| `--no-apply-deletions`        | Disable the deletion pass (backward-compatible mode)                                                                   |           |
| `--save-tr-metadata`          | Write a JSON sidecar for each transport to &lt;outputDir&gt;/.adt/tr/&lt;TRKORR&gt;.json                               | `false`   |
| `--remove-missing-objects`    | Remove local files only for confirmed HTTP 404/not-found objects; other read errors fail without cleanup (orphan sync) | `false`   |
| `--debug`                     | Enable debug output                                                                                                    | `false`   |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
